0.original: The Nonmind drone is trying to catch your attention.

1.original: The Nonmind drone wants to express her thanks to the Vath storyteller and the Vath who took her in. Help her by slaying hippocerfs and gathering three hippocerf skins.

2.original: You slay and skin the hippocerfs. Deliver the hides to the Nonmind drone.

3.original: The Nonmind drone gives the hides to the storyteller and fleetfoot to eat as a gift of thanks. Seeing them enthusiastically eating her gifts, she leaves on a journey to explore the realm.

4.original: Within moments of the drone's departure, the storyteller admits that the taste of the hippocerf skin was near-unbearably disgusting.

24.original: Slay hippocerfs and obtain hippocerf skins.

25.original: Deliver the skins to the Nonmind drone.

48.original: Our new sister is a diligent worker─a tireless contributor to the hive. She mentioned that she wants to talk to you. Please go to her and find out what she wanted to discuss.

49.original: Our new sister said she wants to speak with you.

50.original: We are Nonmind now. We think clearly now! We have left the hive, but we want to go even further. We want to see the realm!

51.original: <click> <click> We of the Nonmind─we are independent. As independent creatures, it stands that we ought be free.

52.original: Loth ast Vath is not like Loth ast Gnath. You may leave at any time. It is no prison. The Vath all live free.

53.original: We owe the Vath a great debt of gratitude. <click> <click> Hunter, could you help us? We need three hippocerf skins.

54.original: Please kill hippocerfs, hunter. Kill them and gather their hides for us.

55.original: Our new sister is a diligent worker─a tireless contributor to the hive. She mentioned that she wants to talk to you. Please go to her and find out what she wanted to discuss.

57.original: Do you have the hippocerf skins, hunter?

58.original: Thank you, kind hunter. <click> <click> Hippocerf skin is truly exquisite─especially raw. Storyteller, please eat this hippocerf skin. Eat it as it is. It is truly exquisite.

60.original: <click> <click> If you insist. <munch> <munch> <munch> Yes...it truly is...exquisite!

61.original: <click> <click> We are glad you like it! Now we intend to go out and see the realm.

62.original: <spit> <spit> <spit> <click> That was truly disgusting. What terrible, terrible taste... But such is individuality.
